items.title_en: Archaeologists Believe That This Mass Grave Found In Latvia Holds The Brutalized Victims Of A Viking Raid
items.title_zh: 考古学家认为，在拉脱维亚发现的这个乱葬坑埋葬着维京袭击中惨遭杀害的受害者
items.summary_en: Gerhards, G. et al. Journal of Archaeological Science: Reports (2026) Copyright Elsevier Archaeologists discovered a 1,200-year-old grave in Latvia that was filled with six people who may have died in a Viking raid. Archaeologists excavating a 1,200-year-old grave in Latvia discovered the remains of six people who may have been brutally killed during a Viking raid.
items.summary_zh: 格哈兹，G.等人。 《考古科学杂志：报告》(2026) 版权所有爱思唯尔考古学家在拉脱维亚发现了一座拥有 1,200 年历史的坟墓，里面埋着六人，他们可能死于维京人的袭击。考古学家在拉脱维亚挖掘一座拥有 1,200 年历史的坟墓时发现了六具遗骸，这些人可能是在维京袭击中被残忍杀害的。

items.title_en: Terrifying Baba Vanga prophecy set for next month as apocalyptic timeline reveals when Earth will end
items.title_zh: 可怕的巴巴万加预言将于下个月公布，世界末日时间表揭示了地球何时终结
items.summary_en: The infamous mystic Baba Vanga has sparked renewed panic after her predictions resurfaced detailing a terrifying event allegedly set to unfold next month, alongside the exact year the world will end. Dubbed the "Nostradamus of the Balkans," the blind Bulgarian clairvoyant has maintained a dedicated following decades after her death, with believers claiming she correctly predicted historic milestones such as the tragic passing of Princess Diana. items.title_en: The Chilling Story Of Ruth Snyder, The First And Only Person Ever Photographed Dying In The Electric Chair
items.title_zh: 露丝·斯奈德 (Ruth Snyder) 的令人毛骨悚然的故事，她是第一个也是唯一一个被拍到死在电椅上的人
items.summary_en: Tensions were high as Ruth Snyder, a woman sentenced to death for the murder of her husband, was strapped into the electric chair at Sing Sing prison on Jan. 12, 1928. Snyder’s case had been a media sensation, and the room was quiet as Snyder cried and prayed. At the moment of her execution, no one noticed the soft click of a camera shutter.
items.summary_zh: 1928 年 1 月 12 日，因谋杀丈夫而被判处死刑的露丝·斯奈德 (Ruth Snyder) 在新辛监狱被绑在电椅上，气氛十分紧张。斯奈德的案件曾引起媒体轰动，房间里一片安静，斯奈德哭泣着祈祷。在她被处决的那一刻，没有人注意到相机快门的轻轻咔哒声。
